title: RAGForge Claim v1
description: A user-visible answer claim. Every claim is backed by one or more raw EvidenceBundle evidence_id values; no generated citation text is accepted.

citation_tokens.description: Only the exact EvidenceBundle.evidence_id is valid. Do not use [1], filenames, URLs, or prefixed/free-form tokens.

x-ragforge-token-rule: Public claim objects expose citation_tokens only. Provider generation JSON may emit either citation_tokens or the equivalent single-field evidence_id; the server normalizes both to EvidenceBundle.evidence_id before persistence or emission.
